details.completeness_justification: All core material criteria except K8 are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 shows full headline financials (sales, EBITDA, EBIT, cash flow). K2 covers the two-segment restructuring and Data & Services growth. K3 includes both the ESA INFLECION contract and EPS-Sterna order. K4 details operational milestones for Sedna satellites, CubeCAT terminals, and VIREON assembly start. K5 reflects Bonnier Capital investment. K6 addresses market positioning through AI data services and vertical integration. K7 shows liquidity management via equity ratio improvement. However, K8’s post-reporting events (VIREON-1/2 launch, Sedna-3/4 construction start, EUR 76.3M OHB order) are missing entirely, making the summary incomplete on this critical item. The overall picture is strong but lacks this final element.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected, with no self-contradictions. The narrative flows from overall performance decline to specific causes (revenue timing shifts), segment performance details, financial metrics deterioration, strategic developments, financing activities, and concluding remarks about balance sheet strength and future outlook. Explanations consistently reference prior statements (e.g., S3 explains S2, S7-S11 detail S1). The organization is clear and progressive, with each sentence building on the previous context. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships between causes and effects are logically sound. The mention of segment figures (S2, S3, S5) does not imply they should arithmetically reconcile to the total, so no accounting contradictions exist.
